## Problem

A short description of the problem or workflow this request addresses. What is hard or tedious today, and what would change with the proposed improvement?

<!--
Feature requests are the primary way to influence the roadmap. Pull
requests are not accepted on this repository — the source code is
private — so the only way a change lands is by being described clearly
here and being prioritised in a release.
-->

## Proposed solution

How you would like CrudGenerator to behave. Include the entry point involved (context menu, MCP tool, settings page, headless service), the inputs, and the expected output.

A sketch of the proposed generated file, the proposed settings entry, or a short diff-style example helps a lot.

## Alternatives considered

What other approaches you have considered, and why the proposed one is preferred. This is also a good place to mention trade-offs (backwards compatibility, settings complexity, additional dependencies).

## Affected scope

- **Generation pipeline stage(s)** involved (full CRUD / a specific stage / a new stage):
- **Build tool(s) supported** (Maven / Gradle Groovy DSL / Gradle Kotlin DSL):
- **Spring Boot versions targeted** (3.x / 4.x / both):
- **Package structures involved** (DDD / Layered / both):
- **Naming profile** (Italian / English / both):
- **API style** (Standard / JSON:API — when the change touches generated APIs):

## Additional context

Mockups, sample inputs/outputs, references to existing plugins or patterns that solve a similar problem, or any other context that helps evaluate the request.
